response.sql: WITH film_daily_rate AS (SELECT rating, replacement_cost, rental_rate / rental_duration AS daily_rate FROM film), rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(daily_rate) AS avg_daily_rate FROM film_daily_rate GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_rate) AS overall_daily_rate FROM rating_stats), filtered AS (SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.avg_daily_rate, rs.avg_daily_rate - oa.overall_daily_rate AS above_average FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE rs.avg_daily_rate > oa.overall_daily_rate) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_daily_rate, above_average FROM filtered;

alternatives.interpretation: "Simple average across ratings" means the overall average of all films' per-day rates (treating each film equally), rather than the simple average of the 5 per-rating averages.
